div.head: X Atr Prol. 1
div.ab: Mearn to gemynde oft ⁊ gelome, þe godcunde lara ⁊ wislice woroldlaga Cristendom fyrðriað ⁊ cynedom micliað, folce gefremiað ⁊ weorðscypes wealdað, sibbiað ⁊ sehtað ⁊ sace twæmað ⁊ þeode þeawas ealle gebetað.

Mearn to gemynde oft ⁊ gelome þe godcunde lara ⁊ wislice woroldlaga Cristendom fyrðriað ⁊ cynedom micliað, folce gefremiað ⁊ weorðscypes wealdað, sibbiað ⁊ sehtað ⁊ sace twæmað ⁊ þeode þeawas ealle gebetað.

Pr.1 Me arn to gemynde oft and gelome þætte godcunde lara and wislice woroldlaga Cristendom fyrðriað and cynedom micliað, folce gefremiað and weorðscypes wealdað, sibbiað and sehtað and sace twæmað and þeode þeawas ealle gebetað.

Ich bedachte in Sorge oft und emsig, dass geistliche Lehren und weise Staatsgesetze Christenthum fördern und Königthum stärken, dem Volke nützen und Ehre verursachen, Frieden bringen und versöhnen und Streitigkeiten schlichten und alle Volkssitten bessern.

I have often and diligently considered with concern that divine teachings and wise secular laws promote Christianity and strengthen kingship, benefit the people and bring honour, make peace and reconcile, settle disputes and improve all the people's ways.

Frequently and often it has come into my mind that sacred precepts and wise secular decrees promote Christianity and strengthen royal authority, further public interests and are the source of honour, bring about peace and reconciliation, put an end to strife and improve the whole character of the nation.

Pr.1 It occurred to my mind often and frequently that divine teachings and wise secular laws advance the Christian faith and enhance the king’s power, support the people and bring renown, make peace and lead to reconciliation and end dissension and wholly improve the habits of the people.

note.seg: Das Original zeigt in diesem Satz viermal Alliteration
The original shows alliteration four times in this sentence
Kirche und Staat im Verein sollen sehtan mid rihtre lage, saca sehtan ⁊ frið wyrcan nach Polity (ed. Thorpe 422¹. 426) = Hom. n. Wulfstan 266. Vgl. Gl Kirchenstaatsrecht 2a. 4
Church and state in union are to sehtan mid rihtre lage, saca sehtan ⁊ frið wyrcan, according to Polity (ed. Thorpe 422¹. 426) = Hom. n. Wulfstan 266. Cf. Gl Kirchenstaatsrecht 2a. 4
The alliterative phrases in this clause are noteworthy; cf. Insts. of Polity, 2; 7, ed. Thorpe, Anc. Laws, ii. pp. 304, 312; Wulfstan, p. 266.
